label: Source
help: Describe a cold source. Values are individual JSON packages. A period of 0 emits them synchronously; a positive period schedules the first value at 0 ms and the rest at that interval. Interval emits its first counter after one period. Empty count means continue until cancelled. Editing or deploying does not start execution.

label: map
help: For each input notification, evaluate the JSONata expression and emit its result synchronously. Use $notification.value (or $rsl.event.value), and $state.index for the zero-based input index. Errors terminate this subscription.

label: filter
help: Evaluate a Boolean condition for each input. Forward the original package only when true. The condition must return a Boolean; errors terminate the subscription.

label: scan · remember
help: Remember a total for this subscription. For each input, evaluate the reducer using $state.total and $notification.value, remember the result, then emit it. The seed is not emitted. The trace shows before/after memory. Explicit shareReplay can share this execution.

label: take
help: Forward at most count values, then complete and unsubscribe upstream. A count of zero completes without subscribing to the source.

label: delay
help: Schedule each next notification after the duration using the RSL scheduler. Source errors propagate immediately. Unsubscription cancels pending delivery. Semantics are RxJS 7.8.2 delay.

label: debounceTime
help: Remember the latest value and emit it after the configured quiet period. A new value replaces the pending value. Source completion flushes the pending value immediately; error or cancellation drops it.

label: switchMap · latest
help: Only the latest inner stream remains subscribed. Each new input first cancels the previous inner, then invokes the named delayedValue Worker with the expression result. The Worker emits once after its duration. Outer completion waits for the active inner. Trace entries show inner subscription and cancellation.

label: Named input
help: An editor adapter identifying one logical input of combineLatest. Connect exactly one upstream stream and one combineLatest. Names must be unique at that combineLatest. Names sorted by code point determine tuple order (for example a then b). This node creates no runtime subscription of its own.

label: combineLatest
help: Connect at least two streams through Named input adapters. After every input has emitted, each new value emits a tuple of the latest values. Tuple positions follow sorted input names. Termination and subscription order follow RxJS 7.8.2 combineLatest.

label: shareReplay · 1
help: Explicitly share one upstream execution within this workflow run and replay its latest value. Fixed contract: bufferSize 1, refCount true. Reset on error; reset on zero subscribers while active; retain the completed cache. Separate Run actions remain independent.

label: Sink · inspect
help: Subscribe to the connected stream when Run is pressed. Display values in the RSL inspector and record complete/error. Each Sink owns a separate subscription; use shareReplay explicitly when sinks should share upstream work.
